purpose: Evaluate Q_rep for an explicitly finite supplied invariant core while preserving source cardinality and time decay.

required.statement: Evaluate Q_rep(t)=1/|N_inv| sum_{x in N_inv} omega_x (1-delta_x(t)/delta_x^max) exp(-lambda t) for an explicitly finite supplied core, with nonzero cardinality and every delta_x_max nonzero.

forbidden.statement: Do not replace finite-core cardinality with measure or integration, use Monte Carlo to repair the representation, remove exp(-lambda t), or regularize zero delta_x_max with epsilon.

deferred.statement: Continuous-core cardinality and provider definitions remain unresolved under TLC-UR-GENPROP-008 through TLC-UR-GENPROP-011.

operations.purpose: Return Q_rep from a finite supplied core and supplied lambda*t value.

inputs.name: finite_core_rows
inputs.semantic_role: Explicitly finite supplied rows containing omega_x, delta_x(t), and delta_x_max values

inputs.name: lambda_t
inputs.semantic_role: Supplied lambda multiplied by t operand for the source decay factor

preconditions.statement: The invariant core is explicitly finite, its cardinality is greater than zero, and every delta_x_max is nonzero.

postconditions.statement: The exp(-lambda t) factor is retained exactly.

invariants.statement: Continuous-core cardinality is not repaired with measure, integration, sampling, or approximation.

steps: apply the finalized finite-core Q_rep expression exactly

error_contract.condition: N_inv is not explicitly represented as a finite collection.

implementation_modes.statement: Evaluate only an explicitly finite supplied core without cardinality repair.

global_invariants.statement: Feature scientific dependency is domain 04; runtime dependencies are empty; no dependency on domains 28, 30, or 31 is introduced.

notes: Finite cardinality and source time decay are normative.
